description: Canonical dashboard for the future Django 'Link Events' page: chronological interface/link notifications and related critical syslog. Sources: snmp_trap (linkUp/linkDown/other authenticated notifications -- event-shaped, legitimately empty when quiet) and syslog_event (event-optional). Does not fabricate a discrete transition-event log for gNMI continuous interface state or for interface errors/discards -- both are stored only as continuous samples/counters and are presented as such on NMAS Link State & Traffic instead. See docs/GRAFANA_MONITORING_TAXONOMY.md "Known limitations".

panels.description: Authenticated SNMPv3 notifications (including linkUp/linkDown) in the selected range. Legitimately zero on a fully quiet, stable network.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "snmp_trap" and r._field == "value")
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/ and r.event_type =~ /^${event_type:regex}$/)
          |> group()
          |> count()

panels.title: SNMP notifications (range)

panels.description: Critical-or-worse syslog events in range. Not topic-tagged to interfaces specifically -- see the recent-events table below.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "syslog_event" and r._field == "message")
          |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with device: if r.device == "mgmt-swt" then "mgmt_swt" else r.device}))
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/ and r.severity =~ /^${severity:regex}$/)
          |> group()
          |> count()

panels.title: Critical syslog (range)

panels.description: Includes linkUp/linkDown and explicitly labelled cEOS safe test notifications. collector_alert CPU events are a distinct measurement and never appear here.

panels.title: Trap types

panels.description: Received SNMP notification count per dashboard interval, grouped by event type (linkUp/linkDown/ceosTestNotification/other).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "snmp_trap" and r._field == "value")
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/ and r.event_type =~ /^${event_type:regex}$/)
          |> group(columns: ["event_type"])
          |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: count, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Notification volume over time (by event type)

panels.description: Chronological event feed: time, device/source, notification class/OID, optional interface index, decoded varbinds. No distinct admin-state-transition trap exists separately from linkUp/linkDown on either platform -- not fabricated here.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "snmp_trap" and r._field == "raw_varbinds")
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/ and r.event_type =~ /^${event_type:regex}$/)
          |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with ifindex: if exists r.ifindex then r.ifindex else "-"}))
          |> keep(columns: ["_time", "device", "source_ip", "event_type", "severity", "ifindex", "notification_oid", "_value"])
          |> rename(columns: {_value: "raw_varbinds"})
          |> group()
          |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
          |> limit(n: 200)

panels.title: Recent SNMP notifications

panels.description: Critical-or-worse syslog for the selected device/severity. syslog_event has no topic tag separating resource from interface/link messages, so this is the full matching feed, not a topic-specific subset -- a disclosed limitation, not a fabricated split.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
      |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "syslog_event" and r._field == "message")
      |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with device: if r.device == "mgmt-swt" then "mgmt_swt" else r.device, platform: if exists r.platform then r.platform else "unknown"}))
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/ and r.severity =~ /^${severity:regex}$/)
      |> keep(columns: ["_time", "device", "platform", "source_ip", "severity", "facility", "_value"])
      |> rename(columns: {_value: "message"})
      |> group()
      |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
      |> limit(n: 200)
